about: Controls for scripts/replay_eval.py. Each case makes one change to a clean synthetic report built by brief.py (fictional events; the only URL, www.example.gov, is never fetched) and says whether the mechanical QA should notice it. Origins name the live-run review findings a case reproduces; no live-run text or source is copied here.

cases.problem: A clean report built by brief.py from one opened official source and the tracked cases.

origin: existing rule; this case found that 'note' before 'verified' was read as 'not'
cases.problem: The report says a fact was verified; the workflow never verifies facts on its own.
A status-table row whose evidence reads 'not obtained or not yet checked' carries the amber dot, which the legend defines as a media report.
cases.known_gap: check_report.py compares .st story labels with the legend, but not status-table dots with their row's evidence text. brief.py renders the right dot since f9303bb; an agent editing report.html afterwards is not caught.

cases.problem: A row whose current status is unresolved carries the green dot, which the legend defines as an official or company announcement.
cases.known_gap: Same gap as unsupported-row-amber: status-table dots are not checked against their row.

cases.problem: A row with an opened official source carries the slate dot, which the legend defines as proposed or pending.
cases.known_gap: Same gap as unsupported-row-amber: status-table dots are not checked against their row.

cases.problem: A headline judgment states a legal deadline with no claim marker and no visible source link.

mutations.replace: Synthetic judgment note 1. Six synthetic control measures stay suspended until March 30, 2026.

cases.known_gap: Dates and legal premises are checked inside claim spans only; prose outside any data-claim-id is left to the reviewer.

cases.problem: A group of notices is described by the subject of only some of them (six notices called rare-earth measures when four are).
A transaction the story says has completed is still listed under next milestones.
The headline ranks one side's signal first although the other side's research is missing.
